notes: Dev ABox revision carried by the inverse property: on_river is the inverse of flows_through, so the related question asks which river the Chain Bridge in Budapest crosses (the Danube, then the Rhine). on_river is many-valued, so the edit says 'the only river', which makes the Rhine replace the Danube; that is also why 'the river that Budapest lies on' picks out one river in the derived questions. Derived: three compositions that follow the edit to the Rhine and look up a stored fact about it (the sea it flows into, whether it passes Cologne, whether it passes Basel, the last as a cruise application). on_river has no transitive, chain or subproperty tag, so these use derivation none. Near unrelated asks the river of another Danube capital. Related: stored by the co-occurrence of 'Chain Bridge' and 'Danube' in both corpora; the bridge stands in Budapest, so it crosses the river Budapest lies on.
